sci-repo-y7-sby-2018-classification-mc-1.title: Year 7 Science — Classification — Safety Bay 2018 (original source MC)
sci-repo-y7-sby-2018-classification-mc-1.coverage: Original assessment questions with source figures. Written parts remain in the bank with marks and parent context. Review-required items excluded from automatic battles.

questions.prompt: State the type of scientist who names and classifies things.
questions.explanation: A taxonomist names and classifies organisms.

options: it makes it easier to identify organisms.
there are only a few organisms that differ from each other.
most discoveries in biology have already been made.
all organisms have characteristics in common.
questions.explanation: Classification makes organisms easier to identify and compare.

questions.prompt: Organisms can be grouped into five major kingdoms. These are:
options: mammals, fish, birds, amphibians and reptiles.
animals, fungi, monera, plants and protists.
animals, fungi, insects, plants and algae.
animals, plants, insects, birds and reptiles.
questions.explanation: B lists the historical five-kingdom framework explicitly used by this source: animals, fungi, monera, plants and protists. Modern classifications can differ.

questions.prompt: Kingdoms themselves can be sub-divided. The sequence of classification following kingdoms is:
options: species, phylum, class, order, family, genus.
class, order, family, genus, species, phylum.
order, family, genus, phylum, class, species.
phylum, class, order, family, genus, species.
questions.explanation: Phylum → class → order → family → genus → species.

questions.prompt: A vertebrate is an animal which has:
questions.explanation: A vertebrate has a vertebral column/backbone.

questions.prompt: The reason for using structural characteristics (rather than colour or size) for classification is:
options: structural features are easy to observe.
individuals of the same type can differ in colour.
organisms change size as they grow.
questions.explanation: All three listed reasons support using suitable structural features in this school model. Structural features may themselves change during development; choose appropriate stable diagnostic features.
